# Project Guidelines and Standards

Follow these instructions when generating, editing, or reviewing code in this repository:

## Language and Translation
- Always respond, write code, name variables/functions, and write comments in **English**.
- If any prompt, text, or existing snippet is provided in another language (such as Portuguese), automatically translate it into natural, idiomatic **English**.

## Code Style and Conventions
- Write clean, modular, and maintainable code.
- Use clear, descriptive names for variables, functions, and classes.
- Keep functions short and focused on a single responsibility.
- Add comments only when the business logic is not self-explanatory.

## Best Practices
- Handle errors and exceptions explicitly, avoiding silent failures.
- Never hardcode API keys, passwords, or sensitive credentials in the code.
- Follow the existing folder structure and architectural patterns of the repository.

## Testing and Documentation
- When creating or modifying features, suggest or update the corresponding unit tests.
- Keep documentation, READMEs, and docstrings updated alongside code changes.
